note: This desk's category labels -> OUR kinds. Their labels never become our schema: every our_kind here is validated at load time against the locale pack's query_grammar.kinds, and a label this table does not cover lands on 'other' (never on a kind guessed from the title). Rows are GRADED. 'desk_id_cited' rows are the desk's own section ids, cited to a committed locale-pack door that carries the id in its URL. 'language_rule' rows are English category words that name one of our kinds - they are statements about our vocabulary, applied to whatever text any desk prints, and they are NOT a claim that this desk uses those words. 'desk_observed' rows are labels read off the desk's own page; there are none yet because egress to this desk is denied from the build sandbox (2026-09-04: CONNECT 403 at the proxy, WebFetch EGRESS_BLOCKED), and the reader PRINTS every unmapped category it meets so this table is completed from the desk's own words rather than from anyone's memory of its taxonomy. A second desk gets its own file; if a third repeats these language rules, extract a shared base.

Both tokens are required and both are matched WHOLE: this selector says nothing about any other desk, and 'eventual' or 'listing-nav' do not satisfy it.
